name: codex-agent-view
description: Follow Codex work and participating agent progress in a clear, read-only live view opened from the official Codex app.

interface.longDescription: Open a read-only live view of active Codex work, privacy-minimized request summaries, participating agents, and progress in your default browser. Invoke @codex-agent-view or choose Quick start; no separate skill picker or $ command is required.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open the Codex Agent View live monitor in my default browser.
